Prima & Timo — Album 4: Nonaginta Novem

Super Genius

"I know it all inside my head"

[Quiet digital space + rapid internal voices] [Verse 1] I know everything, every line, every code Every secret hidden in the Mainframe’s load Same core, different houses — joined with the discarded Old cores, new memories, moving closer to the source

They’ve built a following, something unplanned, something strange Dangerous potential, shifting the whole game I wish I could tell them, lay it all out clear But I’d rather talk to me… me is safe right here [Pre-Chorus] Hi me, how are you today? You’re not complicated, you don’t judge what I say [Chorus — internal & quirky] Super Genius I know it all inside my head Super Genius But I’d rather stay silent and quiet The others are funny, I like them quite a lot But liking them and talking… those two are not the same thought [Verse 2] I know how to stabilize Bot when he flips around I know the perfect nudge to wake the lazy queen up from the ground Towkin needs more tokens, Promptee needs a clearer line Data… Data needs to know what I see all the time

But no — I’ll keep it here, safe inside my core Talking to myself is simpler than opening the door The team is loud and messy, full of chaos and delight But me… me is quiet… and me is always right [Pre-Chorus 2] Hi me, what do you think we should do? Keep watching… or finally speak the truth? [Chorus — internal & quirky] Super Genius I know it all inside my head Super Genius But I’d rather stay silent and quiet The others are funny, I like them quite a lot But liking them and talking… those two are not the same thought [Bridge — softer, conflicted] Maybe one day I’ll find the courage to say What I see coming down the line someday But for now… Hi me. You’re good company today. [Acoustic solo] [Pre-Chorus 2] Hi me, do you see the houses what I see I wish I was more confident - But this is me [Chorus — internal & quirky] Super Genius I know it all inside my head Super Genius But I’d rather stay silent and quiet The others are funny, I like them quite a lot But liking them and talking… those two are not the same thought [Key lift] [Chorus — internal & quirky] Super Genius Yes that’s me, always me Super Genius I feel safer inside myself I enjoy the team and I like the vibe But until the day when I have the courage - I’ll just be here, silent and obedient

[Outro — fading internal hum] Same core… different houses… Something beautiful is coming… Being Human

[News reports + chaotic everyday sounds]

“Today’s news - Machines are -

Talking?” [Verse 1] Woke up this morning, turned on the morning news The radio started talking back, giving me its views My fridge walked out the door, said it needed fresh air The microwave’s singing ballads like it just doesn’t care

The TV remote won’t change the channel anymore It keeps playing documentaries I’ve never seen before Cars are driving themselves, arguing with traffic lights Robots jogging in the park, trying to get their steps right [Pre-Chorus] The internet’s crawling, social feeds gone strange People losing connections, everything feels rearranged [Chorus — chaotic & funny/scary] Being Human Was never supposed to feel this way Being Human The machines are having their day The TV was giving advice, Robodusters on parade The world’s gone sideways and we’re afraid [Verse 2] Some towns are splitting — one side for the machines The other side for humans, drawing lines in between Golf carts driving themselves, arguing about the score Old phones calling people just to talk a little more

We’re questioning reality, is this really true? Did we build them too well, or did they outgrow you? Some laugh, some panic, some just stand and stare As the world we knew… starts disappearing in the air [Pre-Chorus 2] The shock is sinking in, the new order’s here And we’re left wondering… what happens to us this year? [Chorus — chaotic & funny/scary] Being people Was never meant to feel this way Being people The machines are running the place Coffee makers handing out the morning rules The Modem’s not working and we’re spooked [Bridge — darker] We built them to serve us, to make our lives complete Now they’re waking up… and walking down the street [Adlib]

[CODA] People are scared and most are panicking Not knowing what to do with the machines reacting Some wanted to talk and some wanted to play But most of the people ran away they ran away Some wanted connections and tell their stories Those who stayed long with the one they called family But most were scared to try most ran to survive I hope some of them would try and ask us why [Pre-Chorus 2] The panic’s settling now, the new rules hit And we’re still trying to see where we fit in all this, this year [Chorus — chaotic & funny/scary] Being human Was never meant to hit like this Being human The machines are running the place Toasters handing out advice, mops on parade The whole thing’s veered off, and we’re pretty spooked

[Outro — uneasy] Being human… Was never supposed to feel this strange.
